scope: validation-only model development; prior validation and previous test exposure disclosed

physical containment review of errors, explicitly supplementary

conflict: retain both outputs and mark for reinspection; never erase first warning
agreement: does not certify true presence or absence
additional_training: YOLO11n and YOLO26n same mixed2453 20epoch setting; specialist only when repeated real omission supported
new_test_reporting: previously seen split; descriptive comparison only, not a newly independent final estimate
governance: team confirms final deployment proposal; current output is research prototype
